Denise wants an official reply from us on there before Saturday. Can you write it from my board account but save it as a draft, do NOT post it, she wants to read it tonight first. - questions go to clinic@cascaderights.example, people can also call the office 404-555-0187

- people need to know the clinic is still happening and they're still welcome
- don't make it sound like we're mad at the people posting
